mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities that can impair darunavir clearance and increase protease inhibitor levels, while darunavir may increase amphotericin B's nephrotoxic effects through CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and darunavir levels closely; consider nephrotoxicity-minimizing amphotericin B formulations (liposomal); ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation.
